entries.ro: Iar. Cică „ne-am îndepărtat unul de altul”.

entries.en: Choom, seriously. Why do you keep going back?
entries.ro: Choom, serios. De ce te tot întorci?

entries.en: 'Cause I care about her. Can't live without her.
entries.ro: Pentru că țin la ea. Nu pot trăi fără ea.

entries.en: Open your gonk eyes. You could get anyone like her, any day.
entries.ro: Deschide ochii, bă fraiere. Găsești oricând una ca ea.

entries.en: Mehhh… it's just not the same.
Maybe that's the fuckin' point, choom. That it's not the same.
entries.ro: Poate că asta e buba, choom. Nu e chiar la fel.
